'''VargeCorp''' was a manufacturing and direct-sales company that became well-known for its less-than-admirable business tactics. Aggressive marketing and franchising soon saw VargeCorp competing with other big name companies. However, although the company was successful, their products<ref name="HSCS" /> which included personal [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]<ref name="RoE" /> were not of the highest quality. Despite this fact, the company was successful enough to become one of the original sponsors of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. They were a [[contributing sponsor]] of the organization.<ref name="HSCS" />
